name: Fishing Joy
rootCause: The attacker launched a series of attacks on the EOS quiz game Fishing Joy, profiting hundreds of EOS. According to analysis, the attacker used the transaction crowding attack to trigger the game's refund mechanism, resulting in 100% profit.
